_doc: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 for decoupled-serving runs on scheduler-allocated GPU nodes (nscc PBS / ccds-ai Slurm). `name` is the served model id AND the weights path the vLLM server loads; it MUST be the cluster-absolute path to $HOME/scratch/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 and identical on client + server. Because $HOME differs per cluster (per cluster/account), the serve_only wrappers (scripts/serve_only/run_ccds.sh, run_nscc.sh) resolve the remote $HOME at runtime: the server gets MODEL=<resolved path> and the client gets a name-patched copy of this template. The default name below is a concrete placeholder path. FP8, ~35B-A3B MoE: needs 2x40GB or 1x80GB; the wrappers size TP/CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to the chosen cards.
